description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesDemo' that orchestrates the visual animation for a notes app demo video. It manages scene transitions, scene-specific UI elements, and animations using remotion's hooks and utilities, including sample data, themes, and various components for UI elements, status toasts, and cursor animations.

methods.name: NotesDemo
methods.description: Main React component rendering the animated demo of the Notes app, managing scene states, UI transitions, and animations.
